title: About
body:
π1 Elvira Editor

A project-oriented editor and modding toolkit for Elvira: Mistress of the Dark and Elvira II: The Jaws of Cerberus.

Supported environments:
• Elvira I — VGA / RUNVGA
• Elvira I — EGA / RUNEGA
• Elvira II — VGA / RUNIT

The editor combines graphics editing, GAMEPC text, Runtime UI, and CP852-compatible font workflows in one environment. It adds variant management, reproducible builds, status/manifest checks, recovery safeguards, plus Run/Debug workflows.

Character 0x81 is reserved by the engine for HUD cell erasing and is protected from normal editing.

Project: https://github.com/Pivan781005/Pi1-Elvira-Editor
License: GPL-3.0

Credits: Adventure Soft and the original Elvira developers; the preservation, DOS, reverse-engineering and modding communities; everyone testing the editor and reporting edge cases.
